# Fee proposal: civil and stormwater engineering

Dear Priya,

Thank you for your request. We are pleased to offer our civil and stormwater engineering services
for the new house at 27 Corella Rise.

Background

We have reviewed the survey and the concept plans. The site falls gently from the street to the
rear. We have checked the levels at the kerb and gravity discharge to the kerb in Corella Rise is
achievable from the rainwater tank overflow and the driveway grate.

The site is exempt from on-site detention under council's stormwater policy, so no OSD is required.
There is no existing OSD system on the lot. No stormwater quality treatment or MUSIC modelling is
required for a single dwelling. The site is outside the drinking water catchment, so no NorBE assessment applies. No public road works are required.

Scope and fees

    Item  Description                                                  Fee (inc GST)
    ----  -----------------------------------------------------------  -------------
    1     Stormwater concept plan for the DA, confirming gravity          $3,300.00
          discharge to the kerb
    2     Detailed stormwater design, driveway long section and           $4,950.00
          erosion and sediment control plan for the CC
    3     Works-as-executed review and stormwater certificate             $1,650.00
          ----------------------------------------------------------  -------------
          TOTAL                                                           $9,900.00

Total $9,900 including GST.

All amounts include GST.

Exclusions

- Survey and works-as-executed survey (by the surveyor)
- Council application and inspection fees
- Design of the vehicle crossing to council's standard drawing (by the builder)
- Geotechnical advice

Terms

Item 1 is invoiced on issue of the concept plan, item 2 on issue of the CC drawings, and item 3 on
issue of the certificate. Payment is due within 14 days. This offer is valid for 60 days.
